children: Nektar entered a quiet period beginning Sept. 8, 2026 ahead of 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study of rezpegaldesleukin.
Quiet period starts Sept. 8, 2026 and lasts until public announcement of 24-week follow-up data.
Applies to Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata.
Consistent with Nektar’s prior quiet periods for Phase 2b REZOLVE studies and planned data disclosures.
